description: Which benchmarking records are shown as comparators for which governed NYSC course. A course with no entry has no verified comparators yet. Links are a researcher's selection, not an automated similarity match. An optional comparison_caveat is shown wherever the course's comparators are displayed.

links.basis: Pilot comparators chosen for the automotive demonstration in the 2026-10-17 feasibility study (section G): one Sri Lankan, two developing/emerging, and two developed-economy records for an NVQ Level 4 automobile mechanic course.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration and qualification levels; curriculum content comparison only.

links.basis: Same occupation as COURSE-005 (Automobile Mechanic), offered as a 6-month part-time weekend course with no stated NVQ level. The COURSE-005 comparators are reused as same-occupation references, not as equivalent qualifications.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration and qualification levels; curriculum content comparison only.

links.basis: Comparators verified on 2026-10-17 for the Electrician occupation (NVQ Level 3/4, 12-month full-time NYSC course): one Sri Lankan delivered programme, three developing/emerging records (India national curriculum; Philippines NC II and NC III standards), and two developed-economy delivered programmes.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration and qualification levels; curriculum content comparison only. TESDA NC II (residential wiring up to 600 volts) and NC III (three-phase, data measurement and motor control systems) are separate qualifications with different scopes.

links.basis: Comparators verified on 2026-10-18 (Step 14B) for the Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Technician occupation (NVQ Level 4, 12-month full-time NYSC course): one Sri Lankan delivered programme, three developing/emerging records (India national curriculum; Philippines NC II and NC III standards), and one developed-economy national qualification (Australia). No current Singapore programme with substantial RAC content could be verified.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration and qualification levels; curriculum content comparison only. TESDA RAC Servicing (DomRAC) NC II covers window-type air-conditioning and domestic refrigerators only, and Commercial Air-Conditioning Installation and Servicing NC III covers commercial air-conditioning units only; they are separate qualifications. UEE32225 is a national qualification, not a delivered programme.

links.basis: Comparators verified on 2026-10-18 (Step 19A) for the Computer Hardware Technician occupation (NVQ Level 4, 6-month full-time NYSC course): two developing/emerging records (India national curriculum; Philippines NC II standard) and one developed-economy delivered programme (Singapore). No independent Sri Lankan programme with published modules was verified.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration and qualification levels; curriculum content comparison only. No independent Sri Lankan programme with published modules was verified. TESDA Computer Systems Servicing NC II is an occupational standard and DGT's Computer Hardware & Network Maintenance a national curriculum; ITE's Higher Nitec in IT Systems & Networks is a broader, network-focused programme with one computer maintenance module.
